testability.reason: The password reset process and success criteria are not specified

overall_risk.reason: Password reset affects account access, so failures could allow unauthorized access.

risks.description: If reset links can be reused, someone with an old link could gain unauthorized access.

edge_cases: If recovery uses email, the user does not receive the reset email.
If recovery uses email, the user receives multiple reset emails.
assumptions: Recovery uses an emailed reset link; this requires confirmation.
For the successful email recovery scenario, the user has access to the email associated with their account.
clarification_questions: Does password recovery use an emailed reset link or another mechanism?
If reset links are used, how long do they remain valid and can they be reused?
If a new reset link is requested, should earlier links remain valid?
What is the expected behavior if the user does not receive the reset email?
What is the expected behavior if the user receives multiple reset emails?

test_scenarios.title: Reset password using a valid emailed link
test_scenarios.description: If recovery uses emailed links, request a password reset and complete recovery using a valid link.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: If email-link recovery is confirmed, the user can set a new password and log in using it.

test_scenarios.title: Handle a reset email that is not received
test_scenarios.description: If recovery uses email, simulate a reset request where the user does not receive the email.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Requires clarification: the system follows the agreed notification and recovery policy when the email is not received.

test_scenarios.title: Handle multiple password reset emails
test_scenarios.description: If recovery uses emailed links, request multiple resets and attempt to use the earlier and latest links.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Requires clarification: earlier and latest reset links are accepted or rejected according to the agreed link-validity policy.

confidence.reason: The requirement is clear but lacks details on the reset process and success criteria.
